stages.event: You've arrived at the heart of the Glacier, surrounded by towering ice formations that shimmer in the pale Arctic light. The wind is biting, and your breath misting, as you gaze out at the endless expanse of white.

choices.1: You climb higher to survey the surrounding landscape, relying on your ATT/DEF to keep your footing on the slippery surface.
choices.2: You take a moment to scan the horizon for interesting sights or hidden dangers, using your DEX/INT to process the visual data.
choices.3: You calm your racing thoughts, taking slow, steady breaths to center yourself in this unforgiving environment. Your ENE/HAP helps you stay the course.

stages.event: As you walk deeper into the Glacier, you notice crystal formations jutting out of the ice like shards of glass. You come across a small cave, partially hidden behind a wall of ice.

choices.1: You force your way into the cave using your ATT/DEF to break through the ice wall.
choices.2: You carefully investigate the cave's entrance, searching for potential traps or hidden dangers using your DEX/INT.
choices.3: You take your time approaching the cave, observing the surrounding area and noting any signs of wildlife, relying on your ENE/HAP to remain patient.

stages.event: A giant polar bear blocks your path through the Glacier. It looks aggressive and territorial!

choices.1: You stand your ground, baring your teeth and growling to try and intimidate the bear using your ATT/DEF.
choices.2: You try to think of a distracting strategy, attempting to misdirect the bear using your DEX/INT.
choices.3: You radiate confidence, refusing to back down, relying on your ENE/HAP to stay calm.

stages.event: A wolverine charges at you across the Glacier! You need to escape quickly!

choices.1: You force a fast and hard escape, relying on your ATT/DEF to outrun the wolverine.
choices.2: You use your agility to evade the wolverine, quickly dodging and weaving using your DEX/INT.
choices.3: You put up a brave rear guard, trying to stay between the wolverine and your retreating teammates, maintaining your energy and ENE/HAP.

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You come across a chest half-buried in the ice. The chest seems to shift slightly as you approach, and something feels off about it. The lock looks unusually organic.

choices.1: You try to force the chest open with brute strength using your ATT/DEF - might as well go in hot, right?
choices.2: You examine the chest carefully, looking for any hidden mechanisms or clues, using your DEX/INT to analyze the situation.
choices.3: You carefully approach the chest, feeling for any hidden traps or mechanisms, relying on your ENE/HAP to stay cautious.

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You stumble upon a chest partially hidden behind an ice cave. The chest has an old rusted lock and appears genuine.

choices.1: You try to force the chest open with your bare hands using your ATT/DEF.
choices.2: You use your skill to unlock the chest using your DEX/INT, hoping for double loot. Double loot choice
choices.3: You carefully inspect the chest for clues, looking for a hint or hidden mechanism, relying on your ENE/HAP.

stages.event: As you prepare to leave the Glacier, you gaze out at the incredible landscape you've seen over your travels. You feel a sense of accomplishment and pride in surviving this harsh environment.

choices.1: You leave in a forceful, determined manner, using your ATT/DEF to push through the cold.
choices.2: You take a moment to savor the experience, gazing out at the breathtaking view with a sense of serenity, relying on your DEX/INT for balance.
choices.3: You celebrate your survival by dancing on the icy surface, letting go of all your tension and embracing the moment, using your ENE/HAP to fuel the festivities.
